Chapter 6160: Where Are You Going?

Chapter 6160: Where Are You Going?

“Six Tigers Arrival!” A big shot recognized the move.

Six-tiger Emperor finally made his move. Each tiger had a unique ability and didn’t hold back against Li Qiye.

“Boundless Dharma.” A Buddhist palm descended from the sky at the same time.

“Boom!” Mountains and the areas nearby shattered.

“Diamond Emperor!” Others were amazed at the incoming attack.

Diamond Emperor was known for his defense; his physique could withstand attacks from apex emperors. However, this attack was just as potent and caught the crowd off guard.

Three emperors utilized their strongest move after Li Qiye was grasped by his reflection in the mirror.

“Die!” The injured Bloodscythe appeared again: “Blood-ocean Kill!”

He split into numerous copies. As they raised their blades, they summoned a blood ocean of blades gushing toward Li Qiye.

“Four emperors!” Spectators bellowed in horror.

“Not enough.” A desolate god understood just how strong Li Qiye was.

“Just child’s play.” Li Qiye remarked before clapping his palms together.

“Boom!” The four emperors immediately lost control of their dao. Their powers were dragged into the center of his palms and condensed into one move.

“Boom!” Li Qiye conjured a bloody slash with their power.

“Ahh!” Six-tiger and Bloodscythe were cleaved in two; Yin-eye and Diamond had their arms severed to the shoulders.

Spectators couldn’t believe their eyes. Although many big shots have seen Li Qiye in action before, this still shocked them.

The emperors were still alive, albeit astounded by the sudden defeat. Their dao fruits and true fate instantly fled.

“Where are you going? Leave your life first.” Li Qiye smiled and raised his finger, displaying his supremacy. His one finger alone could kill any emperor.

“Indestructible Diamond!” Diamond roared and the others utilized their strongest imperial weapons and merit laws.

Alas, they crumbled immediately. The one who lasted the longest was Diamond Emperor’s physique.

His golden light pulsed infinitely in harmonization with the dao fruits and vitality. A diamond Buddha appeared, capable of lifting the heaven and blocking any law. Unfortunately, it only halted Li Qiye for a second.

“Bang!” It shattered just like the rest, seemingly as fragile as paper.

“Stop!” A radiant golden expanse appeared above, overshadowing the whole world.

“Transcendent Emperor!” Others recognized this extraordinary and forceful presence.

“Boom!” His raw power could push Three Immortals apart.

Emperors in the crowd working together couldn’t stop him as he tried to save his allies.

However, this wasn’t enough to stop Li Qiye’s finger strike. It broke through Transcendent’s impressive attack and continued for the targets.

“Ahh!” They screamed and could only watch their body disintegrate.
